blocks.text: Ovaries egg cells (ova ya oocytes) banati hain aur hormones chhorti hain. Do ovaries hain, uterus ke dono taraf ek ek. Anda-numa (oval) ovary 3-5 cm lambi aur 2-3 cm chauri hoti hai. Is mein bohat si nanhi theli jaisi banawatein hoti hain jinhein ovarian follicles kehte hain; yeh ovary ki functional units (kaam karne wali buniyadi ikaaiyan) hain. Follicles kachche andon (immature eggs) ki parwarish karte hain. Baligh aurat mein har mahine pakne wale follicles mein se ek apna egg cell bahar nikalta hai; is waqiye ko ovulation kehte hain. Ovulation ke baad phata hua follicle ek glandular banawat mein badal jata hai jise corpus luteum kehte hain.
